1. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: first, second and third members formed from laminated composite tape, the first and second members defining a web and __at least one flange__ member being joined to the flanges and extending generally transverse to the web, the first, second and third composite members intersecting to form a void; a filler disposed in and substantially filling the void; at least one layer of composite fabric on each of the members in the area of the filler, __the composite fabric layer being distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

2. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the first and second members include radius areas between the web and each of the flanges, and the fabric layer covers the radius areas, __and the layer of adhesive is a folded sheet of structural adhesive applied over the composite fabric layer__.

4. (Original) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric includes graphite fibers held in an epoxy matrix.

5. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the layer of adhesive and the at least one layer of composite fabric __are applied as distinct layers and__ extend beyond the radius areas.

6. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 1, wherein the at least one layer of composite fabric of the composite members are offset relative to each other, __and the offset fabric layers are not wrinkles or deformations in a single continuous layer but rather are separately positioned fabric layers__.

7. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener, comprising: a pair of composite channels joined together, each of the channels including a web, flanges extending from the web, and radius areas between the web and each of the flanges; a base extending transverse to the web and joined to each of the flanges, the radius areas of the channels and the base forming at least one radius filler zone; a reinforcing member filling the radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the channels and the base, __the composite fabric layer being distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape forming the channels and base__; and, a layer of adhesive surrounding the filler and joining the filler to the composite fabric layer, __wherein the adhesive is a structural adhesive applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

12. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the composite fabric layer includes three composite patches respectively on each of the channels and the base, __and the patches are applied as distinct layers over the laminated composite tape__.

13. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, wherein the layer of adhesive includes a sheet of structural adhesive wrapped around the filler, __and the structural adhesive is applied as a separate layer distinct from any resin within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.

15. (Currently amended) The composite stiffener of claim 7, __wherein the channels are formed from laminated composite tape and the base is formed from laminated composite tape, and the composite fabric layers are applied as distinct layers over the laminated composite tape__.

25. (Currently amended) A composite stiffener for aircraft applications, comprising: an I-section structure formed of laminated composite tape having a web and flanges on each end of the web, the structure including a cap and a base, the cap and base including radius areas between the web and the flanges, __the radius areas being formed by the laminated composite tape__; a cap being joined to the first set of the flanges and the base being joined to the second set of flanges, the cap and the base each intersecting the web in the radius areas to define a radius filler zone; a layer of composite fabric covering the radius areas of the I-section structure defining the radius filler zone, __the composite fabric layer being distinct from and applied over the laminated composite tape__; a reinforcing filler in the radius filler zone; and __a layer of structural adhesive applied as a separate layer surrounding and joining the filler to the composite fabric in the radius filler zone, wherein the structural adhesive is distinct from any resin contained within the laminated composite tape or composite fabric__.
